description: Diagnostic on already-seen frozen48, not fresh qualification. Synthetic ledger intentionally seeds merchant names from expected labels; this isolates intent/date/filter behavior rather than testing merchant discovery. No AI inference or general accuracy claim. App-equivalent comparison permits actual ranking default5 and upcoming default30 but rejects extra filters. Multi-merchant OR is supported by app beyond this narrower model contract.
